periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique diagonal orientation, angled approximately 45 degrees toward the rostrum.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated ovoid morphology with a high aspect ratio, length approximately twice the width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced inferior tapering, with the lowest vertex situated significantly below the horizontal midline of the patch.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Wide, shallow U-shaped posterior boundary at the junction with white dorsal pelage.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Thick transverse band, occupying approximately 30-35% of the visible dorsal-ventral torso profile.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Significant inter-pinna gap, approximately 1.5 times the horizontal width of a single ear region.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Convex and highly smooth semi-circular curvature at the superior margins.

other_distinctive_markers: Saturation and discoloration of distal limb pelage and ventral fur indicating contact with water or mud.
